def score(item: int, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Score each bin for assigning the current item. Higher score = preferred bin.

    Args:
        item: size of the current item to assign
        bins: remaining capacities of feasible bins (all >= item size)
    Returns:
        scores: priority scores for each bin
    """
    if bins.size == 0:
        return np.array([])
    multiples = bins / item
    scores = 1 / np.abs(np.round(multiples) - multiples)
    return scores
genes.thought: The new algorithm evaluates bins using a ratio-based scoring system that prioritizes bins with remaining capacity closest to a multiple of the item size, encouraging optimal grouping and minimizing leftover space.
